notes.title: Northrealm Tribes B0923
notes.content:
Improvements
Reworked the Steam News UI for better readability.

Reworked Windowed Borderless mode, which now functions correctly.

Zoom speed is now set to 1 by default, so you can move the camera immediately without adjusting settings.
Fixes
Fixed a bug affecting the Russian language.
New Content
Added fish to the sea to make the water feel more alive.
Platform Support
Linux support added: players on Linux operating systems can now play the game.

notes.title: Northrealm Tribes B0811
notes.content:
Update: B0811

Loot spawn time changed to 600 - 3600 seconds.
The probability of spawning more than one loot item has been increased.
User interface completely redesigned.
Languages added: Russian, German.
Settings menu implemented.
3D models revised.


Update: B028

Tradership added (animated sequence for trading at the marketplace).
You can now click on all buildings except the storage to open the building menu, where you can demolish, level up, or repair the building.
Buildings lose durability over time and may collapse, disappearing completely.
As a building loses durability, its appearance changes over time, making the damage visible.
Protective walls have been added.


Update: A0710

Minimap improved: icons and other markers now provide clearer information.
The minimap now shows villagers performing tasks in white, while those without a job or assignment are shown in red.
The minimap now indicates the radius where fields near the windmill need to be placed to remain permanent.
Wood and stone roads have been added, but they serve only as decoration.
A smithy has been added (required to construct houses and other buildings).
A marketplace has been added (you can now trade your resources for gold or purchase resources with gold).


Update: A063

Fields near the windmill no longer get damaged.
Minimap icons are now displayed at the correct location.
Villagers who are not working are now displayed in red.
Loot boxes no longer disappear underground when they are washed ashore.


Update: A059

All monitor sizes are now supported for the UI.
Levels no longer go beyond 100.
The XP bar resets back to zero when 100% is reached.
Resources are now properly loaded on the first startup.
